[[Guardsman Onageh]] guards the gate leading into [[Kodlonu Hamlet]].

==Locations==
*[[Istan]]
**{{NPC location|Issnur Isles}} (right outside Kodlonu Hamlet)

==Dialogue==
Before acquiring the [[primary quest]] [[Isle of the Dead (quest)|Isle of the Dead]]:
:''"I'm sorry, but [[Kormir]] has ordered stiff regulations on travel to Kodlonu Hamlet at this time..."''

Non-Nightfall characters or after acquiring the aforementioned quest:
:''"The [[Mehtani Keys]] are wracked by storms and [[corsair]]s alike, so be careful as you venture through. Corsairs are one thing, but even [[Koss]] would think twice before starting a fight with the storm-seasoned fisherman who has to scratch out a living in this rough area. I'm glad you've arrived. The Mehtani Keys certainly need a strong [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspear]] presence."''
